themes.label: AI transforming education systems
themes.definition: AI presented as changing how people learn and as a tool education systems can use for management, teaching and learning.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on using AI in education systems or preparing education for AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic education statements without AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Broad claims that AI changes how people work may additionally be coded AI_ECONOMY_LABOR.

examples.quote: Education systems could use artificial intelligence to change their management, teaching and learning.

themes.label: AI transforming how societies live
themes.definition: AI described as a rapid force transforming societies, including how people learn, work and live together.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing AI as broadly transforming society or daily life without specifying benefits or harms.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages focused on specific sectors only.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI appears only in a list of trends, use AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION instead.

examples.quote: Rapid technological advances in artificial intelligence are transforming societies by changing the way people learn, work and live together.

value.rationale: Uruguay's education-focused passage describes AI as transforming society and proposes using AI in education management, teaching and learning.
